title: ConceptFrontmatter
description: JSON Schema mirror of the gzkit.knowledge.concept_frontmatter.ConceptFrontmatter Pydantic model (ADR-0.30.0, OBPI-0.30.0-01). OKF posture (parent ADR Boundary Invariant 3): `type` is the ONLY required field and is a free string (NOT an enum); unknown producer-defined fields are accepted (additionalProperties: true). Orientation-only — never consumed as enforcement evidence (Boundary Invariant 1).

type.description: OKF concept type — the ONE required field. Free-form string, never a closed enum; unknown values are valid (posture tolerance).

description.description: Short summary of the concept document.

resource.description: Path/URI of the source resource this concept maps to.
